fact_check_verdict: PASS WITH CONDITIONS. UAA News release November 20th read sentence by sentence (quotes exact). NSF award records 2614749 (UAA, $3,824,575) and 2614751 (UAF, $913,037) read via api.nsf.gov, both September 1st, 2026 to August 31st, 2030, EPSCoR RII Focused EPSCoR Collaborations. Alaska's News Source October 9th covers the UAF part. Context from DOE FECM, OSTI DOE-funded reports, 30 CFR 701.5, USGS NMIC, Alaska DNR and peer-reviewed reviews (PMC). Conditions: the $6M is the whole collaborative project, never UAA's own grant; 200 steps is Briggs's 'can take' characterization; four or five is his hope; every AI function is planned, so will or aims to; no Alaska coal source is named by the project; no USGS import percentage is usable (403).

claims.verbatim_source: Labelled non-quotation: absence check. The NSF 2614749 abstractText and every machine-learning paragraph of the UAA release were searched for a training dataset, a data volume or a reactor count; neither states one (angle room analyst C, 2026-11-22).
requires: say not stated, never none exist or empty or to be gathered

claims.spoken: by a different method
claims.verbatim_source: Labelled non-quotation: comparison of the two primary abstracts. The OSTI 1971736 pilot leached coal-based material with acid (bio-oxidation reactors made bio-acid from coal pyrite) at pilot pH setpoints; the NSF 2614749 project evaluates microbial extraction (Shewanella oneidensis) with a virtual assay and reinforcement-learning controllers in a bioprocess digital twin. The processes differ as described; neither is the other.
requires: never say no microbes were involved in the pilot
never call the pilot UAA's
